sloka: मणिं दत्त्वा ततः सीता हनुमन्तमथाब्रवीति ।अभिज्ञानमभिज्ञातमेतद्रामस्य तत्त्वतः ।। ५.३९.१।।।।
transliteration: maṇiṁ dattvā tataḥ sītā hanumantamathābravīti ।abhijñānamabhijñātametadrāmasya tattvataḥ ।। 5.39.1।।।।

translations.english: Sita gave the jewel to Hanuman and said, "This signet ornament is known to Rama very well".
